item.title: Elevated R2 and D1 error rates in EU and Asia Pacific region
item.description: Requests to R2 and D1 from the EU and Asia Pacific regions may experience elevated error rates. We are investigating the issue and working to identify the cause. Further updates will be provided as more information becomes available.
